# Since the actual dataset is not available (Git LFS pointer file),
# create sample data mimicking the Seoul Bike Trip dataset structure
np.random.seed(42)
n_samples = 1000

data = pd.DataFrame({
    'Duration': np.random.randint(1, 120, n_samples, dtype=np.int8),
    'Distance': np.random.randint(1, 100, n_samples, dtype=np.int8),
    'PLong': np.random.uniform(126.8, 127.1, n_samples).astype(np.float32),
    'PLatd': np.random.uniform(37.4, 37.7, n_samples).astype(np.float32),
    'DLong': np.random.uniform(126.8, 127.1, n_samples).astype(np.float32),
    'Haversine': np.random.uniform(0.1, 20.0, n_samples).astype(np.float32),
    'Pmonth': np.random.randint(1, 13, n_samples, dtype=np.int8),
    'Pday': np.random.randint(1, 32, n_samples, dtype=np.int8),
    'Phour': np.random.randint(0, 24, n_samples, dtype=np.int8),
    'Pmin': np.random.randint(0, 60, n_samples, dtype=np.int8),
    'PDweek': np.random.randint(0, 7, n_samples, dtype=np.int8),
    'Dmonth': np.random.randint(1, 13, n_samples, dtype=np.int8),
    'Dday': np.random.randint(1, 32, n_samples, dtype=np.int8),
    'Dhour': np.random.randint(0, 24, n_samples, dtype=np.int8),
    'Dmin': np.random.randint(0, 60, n_samples, dtype=np.int8),
    'DDweek': np.random.randint(0, 7, n_samples, dtype=np.int8),
    'Temp': np.random.uniform(-5, 35, n_samples).astype(np.float32),
    'Precip': np.random.uniform(0, 50, n_samples).astype(np.float32),
    'Wind': np.random.uniform(0, 15, n_samples).astype(np.float32),
    'Solar': np.random.uniform(0, 1000, n_samples).astype(np.float32),
    'Snow': np.random.uniform(0, 10, n_samples).astype(np.float32),
    'GroundTemp': np.random.uniform(-10, 40, n_samples).astype(np.float32),
    'Dust': np.random.uniform(0, 200, n_samples).astype(np.float32)
}).sample(frac=1)

data.head(25)

# Convert the 'PDweek' column to a day of the week name
day_names = ['Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday']
datacopy = data.copy()
datacopy['DayOfWeek'] = pd.Categorical(datacopy['PDweek'], categories=range(7), ordered=True)
datacopy['DayOfWeek'] = datacopy['DayOfWeek'].cat.rename_categories(day_names)

# Calculate the average trip duration for each day of the week
average_duration = datacopy.groupby('DayOfWeek')['Duration'].mean()

plt.plot(average_duration.index, average_duration.values)
plt.xlabel('Day of Week')
plt.ylabel('Average Duration')
plt.title('Average Trip Duration by Day of Week')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.show()
